findings.claim: Typo in the second string-key hunk: the condition is `if (stringMembers.ContainsKey(...))` instead of `if (!stringMembers.ContainsKey(...))`. The string-key member is only added when the key already exists, which cannot happen for the first member. String-keyed members are therefore never added, and duplicates still hit `Add` and throw ArgumentException. This breaks the generation path for string-keyed types and keeps the analyzer crash for duplicate string keys, which is the very bug the requirement describes.
